papers.title_en: DexGraspFlow: Topology-Aware SE(3) Flow Matching for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasp Generation
papers.authors: Bin Zhou, Boyu Ma, Xinyu Zhou, Jiahua Dong, Chuhao Zhou, Yizhou Liu, Hao Wan, Jianfei Yang
papers.evidence: 面向机器人对象抓取的跨具身灵巧手生成
papers.tldr: 不同机械手的几何、关节参数和运动学拓扑各异，跨具身灵巧抓取因此难以建模；仅凭连杆空间关系也不足以刻画手部结构。DexGraspFlow提出条件式连杆级SE(3)流匹配，结合几何信息、双流DiT与运动学树距离注意力，并通过逆运动学恢复关节配置。三种机械手与30组物体—手型组合的仿真成功率均值达95.33%，生成延迟比强基线低约49%，还可适配七种零样本手指移除变体及控制掌面朝向。真实机器人百次试验成功率为91%，显示其跨具身泛化与实际部署价值。
papers.abstract_en: Differences in hand geometry, joint parameterization, and kinematic topology pose challenges for cross-embodiment dexterous grasp generation. However, spatial relations among links alone are insufficient to fully capture the hand's kinematic topology. We propose DexGraspFlow, a conditional link-level $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ flow-matching framework integrating geometric relations and kinematic topology. The framework encodes local object geometry, link geometry, and current poses. A dual-stream DiT models link--link coordination and link--object interaction, while attention biases derived from kinematic-tree distances provide explicit structural information for modeling evolving geometric interactions. The model jointly learns translational and rotational velocity fields, integrates them to generate link poses, and recovers joint configurations through inverse kinematics. Additionally, inference-time palm-orientation guidance enables controllable grasp generation without retraining. Across three robotic hands and 30 object--hand pairs, DexGraspFlow achieves a 95.33\% average simulation success rate, with an average generation latency, including inverse kinematics, approximately 49\% lower than that of a state-of-the-art baseline. Further experiments demonstrate zero-shot adaptability to seven finger-removal variants and palm-orientation control. A model trained on demonstrations for the deployed hand achieves a 91\% success rate over 100 real-robot grasping trials, supporting the framework's applicability to physical grasp execution.

papers.title_en: Embodied Task Agents Can Perform Fine Manipulation through Tactile In-Context Learning
papers.authors: Yubang Wang, Zezheng Huai, Yifei Zhang, Jinhao Wu, Yitong Chen, Haozhe Zhang, Sixian Li, Jingjing Gong, Zhenyang Lin, Ziyang Chen, Xipeng Qiu
papers.evidence: 将视觉、触觉与本体感觉用于具身机器人精细操作
papers.tldr: 具身任务智能体进行精细操作时，需要理解接触如何随动作变化，但针对每项任务更新模型并不理想。本文提出 Tactile-ETA，将专家示范中的动作、相机画面与双侧触觉观测配对，并保留动作起止时刻及触觉变化显著的中间时刻。智能体结合这些示范和当前视觉、触觉及本体感知，通过通用机器人工具选取动作，全程不更新模型参数。四项模拟任务的平均成功率由15.75%升至24%，真实机器人任务则由0%升至60%。结果验证了触觉上下文学习用于精细操作的可行性，也显示示范内容与表征会影响效果。
papers.abstract_en: Can embodied task agents use tactile experience to perform fine manipulation without task-specific model training? We investigate this capability through Tactile-ETA, a system that incorporates tactile experience into an embodied task agent through in-context learning. Successful expert demonstrations show how contact changes during manipulation. We pair each recorded robot movement with its camera views and bilateral tactile observations. We keep tactile observations at the start and end of each movement and add two neighboring time points when the tactile images change markedly in between. The agent combines these demonstrations with current vision, tactile observations, and proprioception to select actions through general-purpose robot tools, without updating model parameters. Across four simulated manipulation tasks, adding tactile observations to the same two expert demonstrations increases average success from 15.75% to 24.00%, with current sensing and execution interfaces held fixed. Further experiments show that performance depends on the sensory content and representation of demonstrations, while comparing agent models on Lift Bottle reveals substantial differences under the same system configuration. On the real-robot tasks, demonstrations with aligned visual and tactile observations increase the task success rate from 0% to 60%. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of using tactile experience in context for fine manipulation and suggest a path toward extending embodied task agents to additional sensory inputs.

papers.title_en: Large Multimodal Models for Direct Robot Control: GPT-6 as a Beginning
papers.authors: Youwei Zhou, Bohan Hou, Yankai Fu, Yaoxu Lyu, Yifan Ye, Shilin Shan, Chen Guo, Jiaming Liu, Ran He, Caifeng Shan, Shanghang Zhang, Jianfei Yang, Zhihe Lu
papers.evidence: 评测机器人闭环操控中的深度、触觉与具身学习能力
papers.tldr: 通用多模态模型的空间理解与智能体推理不断进步，但能否可靠地直接控制机器人仍不清楚。研究系统评测GPT-6 Astra，检验深度感知、具身情境学习和触觉反馈，并测试五项操作基准及真实机器人任务。模型在RoboDojo和RoboTwin 2.0分别取得26.92%与76.0%的成功率，却在要求精确对位、协调运动并预判后果的LIBERO-GeoMotion上仅有11.1%的零样本成功率。结果揭示语义推理与物理执行之间的显著差距，指出精度、动作可行性、安全性及推理延迟是实用部署的关键障碍。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in visuospatial understanding and agentic reasoning enable direct robotic manipulation with general-purpose multimodal models, but their embodied capabilities remain poorly understood. This paper systematically evaluate GPT-6 Astra for closed-loop robotic manipulation using a lightweight agent execution framework. We first probe three fundamental embodied capabilities-depth perception, embodied in-context learning, and tactile understanding-and demonstrate that the model can exploit depth information, acquire simple manipulation strategies from contextual demonstrations, and use tactile feedback to correct its actions. We then evaluate GPT-6 Astra across five established manipulation benchmarks along six capability dimensions. Despite competitive performance on several benchmarks-26.92\% success on RoboDojo and 76.0\% on RoboTwin 2.0-our analysis reveals a pronounced gap between semantic reasoning and physical execution, particularly in consequence-aware action planning, precision, and complex motion coordination. To further examine these limitations, we introduce LIBERO-GeoMotion, a new benchmark of geometry-constrained tasks that require precise pose alignment, coordinated translation and rotation, and anticipation of physical action consequences. GPT-6 Astra achieves only 11.1\% zero-shot success, exposing the difficulty of translating spatial understanding into physically feasible motion. Real-world experiments corroborate these findings: zero-shot execution is feasible for simple tasks, yet persistent deficits remain in motion feasibility, precise control, and physical safety, while substantial inference latency further hinders practical deployment. Overall, our results characterize the emerging embodied capabilities of general-purpose multimodal models and delineate the key challenges toward safe, efficient, and reliable robotic manipulation.

papers.title_en: Latent Bridge: From Video Latents to 3D Geometry via Feature Alignment
papers.authors: Shuai Zhang, Zhanpeng Ouyang, Zhengqing Chen, Ruohong Mei, Shaoyu Chen, Weiqiang Ren, Hui Sun, Qian Zhang, Wenyu Liu, Xinggang Wang
papers.evidence: 从视频潜变量前馈预测相机、深度和三维点云
papers.tldr: 视频生成潜变量与三维重建特征空间彼此割裂，现有流程需先解码 RGB 再重新编码，增加计算并造成接口依赖。本文提出 Latent Bridge，为 Wan2.1 与 V-RAE 分别学习潜变量到几何特征的桥接，可直接预测相机、深度和三维点云。桥接仅用 RGB 视频进行特征蒸馏，冻结视频编码器和几何模型，无需真实几何标注或运行几何预测头。在 Co3Dv2 和 WildRGB-D 上，方法取得有竞争力的重建质量并加快几何解码；同一桥接还可复用于同一潜空间中的图像转视频和文本转视频，无需重新训练。
papers.abstract_en: Video generation and feed-forward 3D reconstruction typically use separate representations, requiring RGB decoding and visual re-encoding to recover geometry from generated latents. We propose Latent Bridge, which connects video generative latent spaces with geometric feature spaces to directly predict 3D geometry from video latents. We develop representation-specific bridges for Wan2.1 and V-RAE, enabling feed-forward prediction of cameras, depth, and 3D point clouds without the intermediate RGB pathway. Each bridge is trained on RGB videos through feature distillation, while the video encoder and geometry model remain frozen. Training requires neither ground-truth geometry nor execution of the downstream geometric aggregator or prediction heads. At inference, the same video latents support both RGB decoding and geometry prediction. The same trained bridge can be reused for image-to-video and text-to-video generation within the same video latent space, without bridge retraining. Experiments on Co3Dv2 and WildRGB-D demonstrate competitive geometric reconstruction quality, efficient end-to-end generation and reconstruction, and faster latent-to-geometry decoding, highlighting latent alignment as a practical and reusable interface between video generation and 3D reconstruction. Our code is available at: https://github.com/hustvl/Latent-Bridge.

papers.title_en: DepState-JEPA: Learning Depth-Grounded State Representation for Visual Perception and Manipulation
papers.authors: Xiujian Liang, Liuyuan Na, Zehao Du, Jiacheng Xu, Weixi Song, Mingyang Sun, Xingjun Ma, Cewu Lu, Jianhua Sun
papers.evidence: 以RGB-D空间表征预测机器人操作引起的状态变化
papers.tldr: 机器人操作预测需要把场景几何理解与动作引发的状态变化联系起来，单靠视觉外观难以充分刻画物体的空间位置。DepState-JEPA基于RGB与深度双流，将两种观测锚定于度量三维空间并融合为共享状态，同时保留模态私有特征，以动作条件转移预测未来视觉表征。模型还利用物体轨迹、机器人本体状态和运动学一致性约束学习。实验显示，该方法提升RGB编码器迁移、特征补全、条件视觉预测与操作成功率，消融结果进一步揭示深度几何和未来状态监督的贡献。
papers.abstract_en: Predictive representations for robot manipulation should connect scene geometry with the state changes induced by actions. Our intuition is that understanding what an action will change starts with understanding where things are: complementary RGB and depth observations ground a common scene representation from which to infer those changes. Guided by this intuition, we introduce \textbf{DepState-JEPA}, a dual-stream RGB--Depth joint-embedding predictive architecture that connects spatial understanding with action-conditioned prediction through a shared latent state, \textbf{DepState}. Built on V-JEPA~2.1, the framework uses depth both as a complementary observation stream and to ground both modalities in metric 3D space, aggregating shared information into DepState while retaining modality-private features for decoding. Ray-conditioned readouts predict local features without target depth; after an action-conditioned transition, the same decoders predict future RGB and depth features using the predicted state and fixed initial private features. Robot-state readouts provide recursive proprioceptive inputs; object-trajectory supervision and calibrated forward kinematics shape state learning through motion targets and joint--TCP consistency. Comparisons show stronger RGB-encoder transfer after RGB-D adaptation, feature completion, conditioned visual forecasting, and manipulation success. Within-model ablations identify contributions from depth content, metric coordinates, and future-state matching, with additional control gains from FK regularization.

papers.title_en: TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
papers.authors: Yicheng Xu, Zhikai Xu, Ziyuan Chen, Yuhang Dong, Tao Zhang, Zhucun Xue, Yong Liu, Jiangning Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向机器人长期行动的具身智能全栈框架
papers.tldr: 机器人需在物理与社交约束中应对环境变化及人类需求，现有具身系统多依赖预设目标或符号化动作，难以评估长期执行。TARSphere构建仿真基础设施与智能体运行框架，让多模态大模型借助分层可执行技能、记忆和反馈行动，并以事件驱动状态机更新任务状态、评估结果。其基准覆盖30个室内场景、360回合和五类成对条件，考察导航报告与取送任务。八种模型评测显示通用模型可胜具身模型，但任务更新和人机协作仍难，碰撞跌倒也表明安全评测不可或缺。
papers.abstract_en: Robots must act under physical and social constraints while adapting to changes in their environment and human needs. Existing embodied-agent systems often focus on specified goals or abstract execution into symbolic actions, limiting evaluation in an evolving world. We introduce TARSphere, a robot-oriented full-stack framework for physically and socially grounded long-horizon embodied agents. TARSphere-Infra runs robot policies in a physics simulator with embodied NPCs and constrained dialogue. An event-driven finite-state machine (FSM) uses completed actions and delivered information to update task states and evaluate outcomes. TARSphere-Harness, its embodied brain harness, lets a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM) act through multi-level executable skills, using observations, hierarchical memory, and execution feedback to revise its decisions. On this foundation, agent-in-the-loop curation aligns task semantics, causal dependencies, and scene geometry to construct TARSphere-Bench: 360 episodes across 30 indoor scenes. Five paired conditions assess perceptual robustness, disruption adaptation, task update, human coordination, and intent understanding for navigate-and-report and fetch-and-deliver tasks. Our evaluation of 8 MLLMs shows that general-purpose models can outperform embodied models, while task updates and human interaction remain difficult. Frequent collisions and falls further motivate evaluating execution safety alongside task success, even with a shared action interface and decision budget.

papers.title_en: From Reasoning to Action: Benchmarking Frontier AI Models on LIBERO-10 Robot Manipulation Tasks
papers.authors: May Espinola, Qifan Zhang, Yu Xiang
papers.evidence: 在LIBERO-10基准评估机器人操作能力
papers.tldr: 前沿人工智能模型虽具备视觉理解、推理与规划能力，但能否将这些能力转化为稳定的机器人操作，尚缺少标准化评估。研究团队构建闭环框架，让模型根据视觉观测和机器人状态，以结构化工具调用控制末端位姿与夹爪，并在LIBERO-10上测试6个模型及3档推理力度，共1800个回合。GPT-6 Astra成功率最高，为44%，Gemini-4 Argon达到43%；提高推理力度通常有帮助，但收益因模型而异且增加推理成本。模型较擅长物体放置，却难以完成精细空间布置和复杂多步交互；公开框架与结果有助于复现评测并推动推理型机器人操作研究。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in frontier AI models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, planning, and tool use, raising the possibility of using general-purpose AI models for robot manipulation without task-specific training. However, their manipulation capabilities have not been systematically evaluated on standardized robotics benchmarks. In this report, we present a unified closed-loop manipulation framework for evaluating frontier AI models on the LIBERO-10 benchmark. Our framework enables models to control a robot directly through visual observations, robot proprioception, and structured tool calls, primarily by specifying target end-effector poses and gripper commands, without task-specific fine-tuning or pretrained manipulation skills. We evaluate six frontier AI models, including GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 5.5, and Gemini-4 Argon, across three reasoning effort levels, resulting in 18 configurations and 1,800 evaluation episodes. Our results show that GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest success rate of 44%, followed by Gemini-4 Argon at 43%. Increasing reasoning effort generally improves manipulation performance, but the benefits vary across models and come at additional inference cost. We also observe substantial differences across tasks, with models performing relatively well on object placement tasks but struggling with precise spatial arrangements and complex multi-step interactions. These findings demonstrate both the potential and limitations of frontier AI models for robot manipulation, highlighting the challenges of translating reasoning capabilities into reliable physical actions. We release our evaluation framework and experimental results to support reproducible benchmarking and future research on reasoning-based robot manipulation.

papers.title_en: Agentic World Action Models
papers.authors: Zhuoyang Liu, Dantong Niu, Botong Zhang, Boning Shao, Jing Wang, Ruijie Zheng, Yuvan Sharma, Runyu Lu, Jiaming Liu, Renrui Zhang, Roei Herzig, Yutong Bai, Ken Goldberg, Danfei Xu, Yuke Zhu, Guanzhi Wang, Linxi "Jim" Fan, Trevor Darrell
papers.evidence: 联合预测视频和机器人动作以支持操作规划
papers.tldr: 现有世界动作模型能够预测机器人操作的视觉未来与动作，却缺少组合式技能复用；基于代码的机器人智能体虽能规划和复用技能，却缺乏对物理动态的预测支撑。AW-0在统一混合专家架构中联合建模代码、未来视频和机器人动作，让代码既组织多步预测与控制，也表示可复用技能。其自动化流程为机器人及人类视频轨迹标注程序，并汇总重复程序形成技能库。在RoboTwin 2.0和实体双臂任务上，模型优于视觉语言动作及世界动作基线，提升语言跟随、语义推理与鲁棒性，连接规划、预测和执行。
papers.abstract_en: Recent world action models provide visual foresight and future prediction for robot manipulation, but lack explicit mechanisms for compositional skill reuse. Agentic robotics combines code-based planning and reasoning with reusable skills, but often lacks predictive grounding in physical dynamics. We introduce AW-0, an agentic world action model framework that integrates code-based planning with joint video and action prediction. We jointly model code, future video, and robot actions as three coupled generative streams within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. Within this architecture a code expert generates parameterized skill routines and control logic while video and action experts generate future visual states and low-level motor commands. Code serves two complementary roles: it structures multi-step prediction and control within the world model and represents skills as reusable programs for subsequent agentic execution. We further introduce an automated curation pipeline that labels robot and human video trajectories with aligned programs and consolidates recurring routines into reusable skill libraries. Evaluations on RoboTwin 2.0 and physical bimanual manipulation tasks show improved task performance over VLA and WAM baselines, alongside gains in language following, semantic reasoning and robustness, demonstrating that agentic code enables connection between planning, prediction and execution within WAMs.

papers.title_en: EgoXperience: Learning World-Grounded Egocentric Representations from Human Experience
papers.authors: Xinhao Ji, Hui En Pang, Hao Li, Kairui Hu, Jiner Wang, Mingze Sun, Ziang Cao, Yalun Dai, Thang Luu, Qin Ma, Hongyi Chen, Yukang Cao, Fangzhou Hong, Zhaoxi Chen, Ziwei Liu
papers.evidence: 联合重建观察者运动、场景几何及手物交互
papers.tldr: 第一人称视频活动重建不仅要恢复单个三维要素，还需让观察者运动、环境几何与手物交互在统一世界坐标中保持一致，现有方法和数据缺乏联合重建及对齐监督。EgoXperience构建自动标注、数据集、统一模型与基准；其标注引擎结合几何验证物体跟踪和基于SLAM的世界对齐。模型输入单目视频及首帧物体掩码，单次前向联合恢复相机、场景、手和物体。实验较强基线将相机、手部和深度误差分别降低68.9%、65.6%、42.9%，物体姿态得分提高28%，并提供50小时数据与评测基准。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing human activity from egocentric video requires more than recovering individual 3D components: the observer's motion, surrounding geometry, and hand-object interactions must fit together in a consistent world. Achieving this coherence requires both joint reconstruction and aligned supervision, yet existing methods and datasets offer limited support for either. We present EgoXperience, a full-stack paradigm that addresses these needs through data collection, automatic annotation, unified modeling, and benchmarking. Central to EgoXperience is an automatic annotation engine, EgoX-Engine, that couples geometrically verified object tracking with SLAM-based world alignment, yielding consistent supervision for the camera, scene, hands, and objects. This yields EgoX-Data-6M, a 50-hour dataset of task-driven manipulation and locomotion within and across indoor and outdoor environments, with second-level task captions. We carefully select one hour across these activity categories as EgoX-Bench to evaluate joint reconstruction. To translate this supervision into reconstruction, we introduce EgoX, trained with EgoX-Data-6M and complementary annotations from additional public datasets. Given monocular egocentric video and first-frame object masks, our model achieves joint metric reconstruction of the camera, scene, hands, and objects in a shared world coordinate frame with a single forward pass. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across scene estimation and world-space hand-object pose recovery. Against the strongest evaluated baselines, EgoX reduces camera, hand, and depth errors by 68.9%, 65.6%, and 42.9%, and improves object pose scores by 28.0%.

papers.title_en: GALA: Geometry-Aware Language Model for Controllable Object Arrangement
papers.authors: Chucheng Xiang, Runze Wang, Zhi Deng, Ruchao Bao, Yuanwei Zhang, Yuxuan Xie, Hanliu Wang, Liangzhen Fei, Wenzheng Wu, Cheng Wan, Peifeng Li, Zhongyuan Liu, Ligang Liu
papers.evidence: 通过点云感知预测物体位姿并执行场景交互式布局
papers.tldr: 真实感三维场景生成需要准确处理支撑、包含等细粒度摆放关系，但依赖定向包围盒的既有方法难以感知物体真实几何，容易产生不合理布局。GALA将点云显式感知引入语言模型，依据场景上下文和文本指令，自回归地逐个预测目标物体的六维位姿，并通过几何与文本对齐预训练及摆放微调进行训练。论文还整理覆盖多类房间与家具布局的多源场景数据集，并设计规划、摆放、验证的文本驱动生成流程。基准实验显示，GALA显著优于缺乏显式几何推理的基线，为可控三维物体布置提供了更具几何意识的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning about fine-grained placement constraints, such as support and containment, is essential for realistic 3D scene creation. It remains a significant challenge for existing methods that rely on simplified object representations like oriented bounding box (OBB), which are blind to the detailed geometry. To address this limitation, we introduce GALA, a geometry-aware language model with explicit point cloud perception for controllable object placement. Our model performs autoregressively by predicting the 6D pose of one target object at a time conditioned on the scene context and placement instruction. We utilize a two-stage training strategy: the first stage aligns geometric and textual modalities through pretraining tasks, and the second stage fine-tunes the model for placement. To facilitate this task, we also curate a multi-source scene dataset covering diverse room types and fine-grained furniture arrangements, which will be open-sourced for community benefit. Experiments on our benchmark show our model significantly outperforms baselines without explicit geometric reasoning. We further develop a multi-stage plan-place-verify agent pipeline that uses the model for text-driven scene generation. Project Page: https://xccelephant.github.io/paper/gala/

papers.title_en: OrTeN: Neural Inverse Graphics for Joint Terrain and Line-scan Camera Trajectory Reconstruction
papers.authors: Josef Biberstein, Sertac Karaman
papers.evidence: 从卫星影像重建地形表面并联合优化相机轨迹
papers.tldr: 行星数字地形图支撑着陆点选择、地形相对导航与地质分析，但传统多视图立体重建需处理相机误差、光照变化和视差不足。OrTeN采用神经逆渲染，直接从校准线扫影像及初始相机位姿出发，联合优化纹理高程图、轨迹修正与高频指向抖动，无需测距数据或初始粗略地形。它用表面投影图像块互相关约束多时相观测，并以反射模型和阴影拟合不同光照。四处数据的地形均方根误差为0.43至16.18米，展示了联合重建行星地形与相机轨迹的可行性。
papers.abstract_en: Digital terrain maps (DTMs) are used for landing site selection, terrain-relative navigation, and geological analysis in planetary exploration. Existing state-of-practice reconstruction techniques for creating DTMs from satellite imagery use multi-view stereo, requiring complex pipelines for dealing with camera error, changing illumination, and images with limited disparity. This work introduces Orbital Terrain Networks (OrTeN), a DTM construction method that uses neural inverse rendering to jointly optimize a textured height map and orbital camera corrections from line-scan satellite images. OrTeN operates directly on calibrated line-scan images with pixel values expressed as radiance factor (I/F) and corrects both broad trajectory pose inconsistencies and high-frequency pointing jitter jointly with surface reconstruction during training. Surface-projected patch normalized cross-correlation (NCC) enforces consistency between observations of the same terrain, refining an initial rough reconstruction. A semi-empirical reflectance model and shadow rendering are used to fit surface appearance from multi-date imagery with differing solar illumination. OrTeN requires only calibrated line-scan images and initial camera poses and does not use any structural priors including ranging/depth measurements or initial rough DTMs. OrTeN is evaluated on four planetary imagery datasets. Aligned terrain RMSEs are 2.35 m at Jezero Crater, 2.82 m at Gale Crater, 16.18 m at Olympus Mons, and 0.43 m at McGetchin Crater.

papers.title_en: Geometry Regularization for Vanilla NeRF via Self-Supervised Cross-Ray Consistency
papers.authors: Zongji Wang
papers.evidence: 通过跨射线一致性正则化NeRF场景几何
papers.tldr: NeRF 通过连续辐射场合成新视角，但仅凭输入图像，形状与辐射可能相互补偿，使密度场中的几何出现噪声和偏差。本文为香草 NeRF 增设几何优化分支，从密度场采样候选表面点，并用不同方向、交于同一点的虚拟射线检验颜色一致性。方法还依据可见性加权结果惩罚外观预测不一致点的不透明度，并鼓励局部法线平滑，全程无需真实深度或表面法线标注。在八个 Replica 场景中，平均倒角距离较香草 NeRF 降低 30.8%，说明自监督跨射线一致性能够缓解几何歧义、提升场景形状质量。
papers.abstract_en: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) achieve high-quality novel-view synthesis by representing a scene as a continuous volumetric radiance field. However, the geometry encoded by the density field of vanilla NeRF can be noisy and inaccurate, since different combinations of shape and radiance may explain the same input images. To reduce this ambiguity, we augment vanilla NeRF with a geometry-optimization branch based on self-supervised cross-ray consistency. Specifically, this branch samples candidate surface points from the density field, generates virtual rays that intersect at each point from different directions, and renders their appearance using the NeRF network. Based on the visibility-weighted color consistency across these rays, we constrain the implicit geometry. We further regularize the implicit geometry by penalizing opacity at candidates with inconsistent appearance predictions and encouraging local normal smoothness. These geometric constraints are derived from the NeRF predictions and require no ground-truth depth or surface-normal supervision. Experiments on eight Replica scenes show that the proposed method reduces the mean Chamfer distance by 30.8% compared with vanilla NeRF.

papers.title_en: HRoPE: Homography Relative Positional Encoding
papers.authors: Huachen Gao, Yang Yang, Xiaoqian Liang, Xingyu Chen, Youjia Zhang, Qi Zhang, Baorui Ma, Anpei Chen, Wei Yang
papers.evidence: 为多视图Transformer设计基于局部三维表面的几何位置编码
papers.tldr: 多视角变换器常用几何相对位置编码建立跨视图关联，但基于相机视锥或射线深度的传感器中心方案，主要描述观测位置，难以表达图像块对应区域的表面形状。本文提出 HRoPE，将局部区域建模为倾斜三维平面，并把平面诱导的单应变换作为相对变换注入注意力，以帮助校正透视畸变、对齐跨视角特征。平面参数可在新视角合成目标下端到端预测，也可由基础模型获得，无需真实几何标注。在三个数据集上的实验显示，最佳变体持续优于所比较的几何位置编码，体现了显式表面几何先验的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Geometric Relative Positional Encoding has become the primary mechanism for injecting spatial inductive biases into multi-view transformers. Existing designs condition attention on camera-level frustums or ray-marched depth, associating cross-view tokens through the sensor geometry. Such sensor-centric formulations, however, describe only where a token is observed from, leaving the rich surface geometry of the scene region depicted by the token. In this paper, we advocate a shift toward surface-aware positional encoding that explicitly grounds patch tokens in the geometry of physical surfaces. We introduce HRoPE, which represents the local geometry of each patch as a slanted 3D plane, following the slanted support-window assumption of classical multi-view stereo. We inject token-level, plane-induced homographies into attention as relative transformations. This equips the transformer with a geometric prior for rectifying perspective distortions and aligning patch features across viewpoints. Our encoding requires no ground-truth geometry: the plane parameters can be predicted end-to-end under a view-synthesis objective alone, or derived from foundation models. Extensive experiments on RealEstate10K, CO3Dv2, and DL3DV show that our best variant of HRoPE consistently outperforms the evaluated geometric positional encodings for novel view synthesis. Extensive ablations and analysis show the effectiveness of the proposed encoding. Please refer to our project page at: https://gaohchen.github.io/HRoPE

papers.title_en: RayCo4D: Ray-Conditioned Continuous Motion Model for Monocular 4D Dynamic Reconstruction
papers.authors: Yuanxiang Ni, Xianliang Huang, Ruihan Hou, Feng Xie, Hao Zhang
papers.evidence: 从单目视频恢复动态三维场景与连续运动
papers.tldr: 单目视频动态四维重建需要从噪声观测和间歇可见片段中推断运动；长程轨迹虽提供几何约束，却难以形成共享且连续的运动表示。RayCo4D分离视觉测量与潜在三维状态，以相机射线约束参考时刻查询，并通过局部多对多关联融合图像和深度观测。模型估计稀疏时刻的位姿与速度，以加速度白噪声先验连接状态并实现连续插值，再将共享运动传给高斯基元，以局部残差表达细粒度非刚性形变。实验显示其新视角合成质量具竞争力，在快速运动和轨迹不完整时改善结构及时间一致性，并支持连续时间渲染。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing dynamic 3D scenes from monocular video requires inferring motion from noisy and intermittently visible observations. Long-range tracks provide valuable geometric constraints, but integrating their fragmented temporal coverage into shared, continuous motion remains challenging. We introduce RayCo4D, a ray-conditioned continuous motion model for monocular 4D reconstruction that explicitly separates visual measurements from latent 3D motion states. Each track is associated with a reference-time 3D query constrained to its camera ray, and its image and depth observations constrain shared latent motion nodes through local many-to-many associations. Each node maintains an $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ pose and body-frame velocity at sparse support times. A white-noise-on-acceleration process prior couples neighboring states and defines continuous-time interpolation, allowing observations across visibility intervals to jointly constrain the same latent state sequence. The inferred shared motion is transferred to Gaussian primitives through dual-quaternion blending, while reference-anchored local $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ residuals capture fine-scale non-rigid deformation beyond the shared scaffold. Experiments on diverse monocular dynamic scenes show that RayCo4D achieves competitive novel-view synthesis quality, improves structural and temporal consistency under rapid motion and incomplete tracks, and supports continuous-time rendering.

papers.title_en: PlanarCityLoc: Breaking Silhouette Ambiguity in LoD Aerial Localization via 3D Planes
papers.authors: Oussema Dhaouadi, Shao Jie Hu-Chen, Jakob Gollreiter, Samir Jusufi, Nikolas Rieger, Caroline Wendlandt, Christian Wender, Jingfeng Mao, Guangming Wang, Zuria Bauer, Marc Pollefeys, Daniel Cremers, Olaf Wysocki
papers.evidence: 利用三维平面对应关系优化相机位姿
papers.tldr: 城市环境中的GNSS信号常受干扰，轻量级、无纹理的LoD城市模型因此成为无人机定位的几何地图选择。现有轮廓对齐可能让不同相机位姿难以区分，并因建筑分割误差而偏向错误结果。PlanarCityLoc先做几何感知初始化，再匹配图像平面片与模型立面、屋顶平面，通过三维到二维对应关系和PnP优化位姿。该方法无需针对数据集训练或微调，在UAVD4L-LoDv2与Swiss-EPFLv2上取得所评估免训练LoD方法中的最佳定位召回，为轻量地图定位提供更可靠的几何依据。
papers.abstract_en: Aerial visual localization is crucial for autonomous drone navigation in urban environments where GNSS signals are often degraded. Lightweight textureless Level-of-Detail (LoD) city models provide a geometric map alternative to textured assets. Existing silhouette-based methods rely on image-space alignment, which can leave different camera poses indistinguishable and favor incorrect poses when segmentation errors distort the building outlines. We present PlanarCityLoc, which moves beyond silhouette overlap by leveraging the planar geometry of building facades and roofs. Following geometry-aware initialization, we match image-side planar patches to LoD model planes and use the resulting 3D-to-2D correspondences to refine pose with Perspective-n-Point (PnP). The framework uses off-the-shelf geometry and segmentation models without dataset-specific training or fine-tuning. Experiments on UAVD4L-LoDv2 and Swiss-EPFLv2 achieve state-of-the-art localization recall among the evaluated off-the-shelf LoD-based methods. By grounding image-space alignment in 3D planes, PlanarCityLoc enables more accurate aerial localization with lightweight, textureless city maps.

papers.title_en: Uncertainty Gates the Gradient: Adaptive Updates for Generalized Few-Shot 3D Segmentation
papers.authors: Yifei Zhao, Fanyu Zhao, Shengtang Wu, Han Zhang, Ruike Cao, Yinsheng Li
papers.evidence: 直接研究广义少样本三维点云语义分割与自适应方法。
papers.tldr: 广义少样本三维点云分割依赖稀疏且易受遮挡影响的支持标注，低质量样本可能诱使模型学习不稳健的几何模式。针对这一问题，UGA依据支持标注与新类伪标签的类内离散度评估任务可靠性，并以不确定性门控残差梯度更新，另用UB-Filter保留高置信伪标签。该方法在ScanNet200和ScanNet++的1样本、5样本设置中，较最强既有基线平均提升3.08个调和均值IoU。结果表明，将不确定性用于控制是否更新，可提升模型从可靠样本学习新语义的能力。
papers.abstract_en: In generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation, support annotations are often compromised by sparsity and occlusion. Blindly adapting to such low quality samples risks learning spurious geometric patterns rather than robust novel concepts. Although 3D Vision-Language Models have been introduced to sup plement supervision, the potential of uncertainty to actively govern adaptation dynamics remains underexplored. Existing signal-level methods like loss reweight ing fail to prevent unreliable episodes from steering the optimization trajectory. To address this, we propose Uncertainty-Gated Adaptive (UGA), to the best of our knowledge the first framework that elevates uncertainty to update-level gating for generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation. The core mod ule, Uncertainty-Gated Update (UG-Update), estimates episodic reliability via intra-class dispersion over merged support and pseudo-labeled novel supervision, and selectively gates residual gradient updates. This encourages the model to learn novel semantics from reliable episodes while attenuating updates during unreliable ones. Complementing this, we introduce an Uncertainty-Based Pseudo Label Filter (UB-Filter) to enforce learning from high-confidence dense signals. On ScanNet200 and ScanNet++ (1-/5-shot), UGA sets new state of the art with an average +3.08 HM IoU over the strongest prior baseline.

papers.title_en: OmniVLoc: Topo-metric Visual Localization for Omnidirectional Cameras
papers.authors: Zhuo Yu, Shuyang Zhang, Huihua Zhu, Wenjia Ouyang, Zuo Zuo, Jianhao Jiao, Yilong Zhu, Xiaopin Zhong, Zongze Wu
papers.evidence: 结合单目深度、尺度感知位姿图与球面束调整进行视觉定位
papers.tldr: 全景相机能够提供环视视野，缓解传统视觉定位的视场限制，但场景内容变化与光照变化仍会导致定位精度和鲁棒性不足。OmniVLoc采用拓扑—度量框架，融合全局地点识别和单目深度估计，并通过尺度感知位姿图、球面束调整恢复查询帧的度量位姿。系统还设置分层验证机制，筛除各阶段的错误结果。在公开及自建数据集上的实验验证了其准确性与可靠性，为环视视觉定位提供了完整方案。
papers.abstract_en: Omnidirectional cameras provide surround-view information, significantly overcoming the field-of-view constraints for traditional visual localization systems. However, existing localization systems fail to fully exploit the characteristics of omnidirectional cameras, struggling to deliver accurate and robust localization performance amidst scene content variations and illumination-induced appearance changes. In this work, we propose OmniVLoc, a surround-view localization system based on a topo-metric framework. By integrating state-of-the-art global place recognition and monocular depth estimation methods, we introduce a multi-constrained visual localization paradigm. By solving a scale-aware pose graph and performing precise spherical bundle adjustment, we accurately recover the metric-level pose for each query frame.Furthermore, a hierarchical verification mechanism is designed to filter out erroneous outputs across different stages, effectively bolstering the overall system robustness. Extensive experiments on both public and our custom datasets validate the superior accuracy and reliability of OmniVLoc. To benefit the community, our source code and dataset will be made publicly available upon publication.

papers.title_en: Register Anything Model for Generalizable and Robust Point Cloud Registration
papers.authors: Zheng Qin, Junhua Xi, Yan Huang, Jiahong Lai, Anwen Huang, Qiong Li, Guangda Zhang, Kai Xu
papers.evidence: 统一模型处理跨域点云并估计六自由度变换
papers.tldr: 点云配准方法往往专用于单一领域，跨传感器、室内外环境及物体场景时，尺度、噪声、点密度和结构差异会导致性能下降。RAM以多领域数据训练统一模型，并依据几何特性联合体素化与归一化，保留局部结构的同时统一分辨率。其分层由粗到细架构使用高效几何变换器建模局部一致性，缓解体素化离散噪声并降低计算开销。在12个基准上，RAM的内点率与配准召回率达到先进水平，且优于各领域单独训练的模型，体现了跨域泛化与稳健配准能力。
papers.abstract_en: We present Register Anything Model (RAM), a unified model for generalizable 3D point cloud registration that robustly estimates 6-DoF transformations across diverse domains spanning sensors and environments. Existing registration methods are typically tailored to a single domain, with carefully tuned architectures and hyperparameters, and thus degrade markedly when applied to novel domains. We bridge this gap by training a single model on diverse data from indoor, outdoor, and object domains. A central challenge is the severe geometric discrepancy across domains, i.e., differences in scene scale, sensor noise, point density, and structural patterns, which hinders processing with a unified point-based model. To address this, we introduce a geometry-aware normalization strategy that jointly voxelizes and normalizes point clouds into a standardized geometric space, adaptively based on their geometric properties to preserve salient local structures while standardizing resolution. Built on this normalization, RAM follows a hierarchical coarse-to-fine paradigm, and employs an efficient geometric transformer that models local geometric consistency instead of globally over all points. This design mitigates discretization noise introduced by voxelization, and improves computational efficiency. Extensive experiments on 12 benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in terms of inlier ratio and registration recall. Notably, our method outperforms the counterparts trained on each separate domain, showing superior generalization capability.

papers.title_en: HumanSkill-4D: Training-Free Language Querying of Animatable Gaussian Avatars in Space and Time
papers.authors: Junsu Kim, Naeun Kim, Dongyoon Han, Seungryul Baek
papers.evidence: 通过语言查询分割可动画化三维角色的语义部件
papers.tldr: 可动画高斯化身的语言交互需要定位身体部位、服饰及其随时间变化的动作区间，但相邻区域难区分，细粒度动作又常在图像中外观相似。HumanSkill-4D无需训练，按化身建立语义记忆，将类别映射到持久高斯区域，并借助多模态大语言模型解析外观、关系和功能描述；再把运动条件编成算子程序，在驱动关节轨迹中检索匹配区间。三个新标注基准上的实验显示，该方法在部件分割及三维、四维指代分割中优于基线，且每个化身仅需数分钟设置。它以紧凑记忆和可追溯选择支持局部编辑与动作检查。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce avatar referring segmentation, which selects regions of animatable Gaussian avatars from language queries. A query can also specify a pose or motion to select matching intervals. This lets users interact with avatars for local editing and motion inspection. However, making these selections with existing language Gaussian splatting methods poses two challenges: adjacent parts and garments are hard to separate and may be referred to indirectly (region ambiguity), while fine-grained motions can look alike in RGB (motion ambiguity). We address these challenges with HumanSkill-4D, a training-free framework that shares a multimodal large language model (MLLM) and geometric operators across avatars. For each avatar, a semantic memory links body-part and garment categories to persistent Gaussian regions and appearance descriptions. The MLLM uses category names and descriptions to select categories by appearance, relation, or function. To find matching intervals, it composes operators into programs that check query conditions on driving joint trajectories stored in a motion memory. These category choices and operator outputs make selections traceable, while composing or adding operators supports new motion conditions. To evaluate this task, we introduce three human-annotated benchmarks and show that HumanSkill-4D outperforms the baselines in part segmentation and 3D and 4D referring segmentation, with compact memories and only minutes of setup per avatar.

papers.title_en: RAHF-Net: Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion for LiDAR-Assisted RGB Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: R. D. Lin, Pengcheng Weng, Ge Wang, Han Ding, Fei Wang
papers.evidence: 融合激光雷达三维语义特征，改善图像平面上的场景语义分割。
papers.tldr: 针对激光雷达辅助 RGB 语义分割，现有方法常将点云压成浅层深度图并均匀融合，难以保留三维结构，也未考虑远近距离下激光雷达可靠性不同。RAHF-Net 将预训练柱面体素特征投影到图像平面，并以软距离掩码调节融合：近场利用几何信息增强，远场补充视觉上下文。在 KITTI-360 上取得 65.76 mIoU，较 CMX 提升 1.45 个百分点；在 DELIVER 上对恶劣天气、光照退化和传感器损坏也更稳健。该方法展示了保留三维先验并按距离适配融合的价值。
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies LiDAR-assisted RGB semantic segmentation, where LiDAR point-cloud features improve dense pixel-wise predictions in the RGB image plane rather than 3D point labels or detections. Existing 2D fusion methods often project point clouds into shallow depth/range maps and apply spatially uniform fusion, discarding rich 3D structure and ignoring the range-dependent reliability of outdoor LiDAR. We propose RAHF-Net, a Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion Network. Its Cylindrical-to-Perspective (C2P) module projects pretrained cylindrical voxel features into the image plane, preserving structured 3D semantic priors. A Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion (RAHF) module then uses a soft depth-derived range mask to perform LiDAR-guided geometric enhancement in reliable near-field regions and visual-context enhancement in sparse far-field regions. On KITTI-360, RAHF-Net achieves 65.76 mIoU, outperforming representative RGB-only and RGB-LiDAR baselines, including CMX by 1.45 points. Experiments on DELIVER further demonstrate improved robustness under adverse weather, illumination degradation, and sensor corruption.

papers.title_en: TokenFlow: Latent Token Rectified Flow Matching for 3D Point Cloud Generation
papers.authors: Linhao Wang, Dongjin Huang
papers.evidence: 以层级令牌表示三维形状并生成点云部件结构
papers.tldr: 3D 点云生成既要捕捉部件布局与表面细节，也要保持点集的置换等变性；将整形状压缩为单一向量的潜在模型，往往难以保留部件级结构。TokenFlow 把形状表示为一组潜在令牌，以远少于点数的令牌聚合全局上下文，计算开销为 O(NM)，并联合令牌整流流与条件点流生成。实验中，它在 ShapeNet 的飞机、汽车和椅子类别上取得最佳 MMD 与覆盖率，1-NNA 接近最强基线；在 ModelNet10 上，潜在令牌集的线性评估准确率最佳。结果显示，令牌式分层表示能有效支持点云生成与形状表征。
papers.abstract_en: 3D point clouds generation requires capturing both part-level layout and surface detail while preserving permutation equivariance. Existing latent generative models often encode an entire shape into a single vector, which limits their ability to retain part-level structure. We propose TokenFlow, a hierarchical flow matching framework that represents each shape as a set of latent tokens and couples a rectified flow over these tokens with a conditional flow over points. A bottleneck of $M \ll N$ learnable tokens aggregates global context through cross-attention at $O(NM)$ cost. On ShapeNet, TokenFlow achieves the best MMD and coverage across airplane, car, and chair, while obtaining 1-NNA comparable to the strongest baselines. On ModelNet, its learned latent set reaches the best reported linear-evaluation accuracy on ModelNet10. These results show that representing a shape as a set of latent tokens, aggregated at $O(NM)$ cost, provides an effective representation for 3D point cloud generation.

papers.title_en: Think-Capture: Active 3D Geometry Acquisition for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Junjie Wang, Zhihao Yuan, Yunhan Tang, Sheng Xu, Jiaqi Mao, Xiaoyu Ye, Yueru Luo, Xu Yan, Chun-Mei Feng, Zhen Li
papers.evidence: 主动获取场景三维几何并编码物体与相机状态
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型虽擅长二维识别，却常在稀疏视角、遮挡和透视变化下误判三维关系；把所有帧密集融合又会增加计算与上下文开销，并可能让模型盲信不准确的几何估计。Think-Capture按问题先找关键物体，再按需提取其三维几何，并将物体与相机状态压缩为结构化文本。分层组相对策略优化让模型学习何时采信工具证据、何时依靠视觉线索；其在三项空间基准上均优于骨干模型，并对坐标和掩码扰动保持稳健。系统可在单张24GB显卡运行，也作为异步高层推理器部署于机器人，体现了按需几何推理的实用价值。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at 2D recognition but often fail to maintain consistent 3D relations across sparse viewpoints, leading to spatial hallucinations under occlusion and perspective changes. Existing methods commonly fuse all frames with dense geometry, incurring substantial computation and context overhead while encouraging blind reliance on imperfect estimators. We present Think-Capture, a query-conditioned framework that first identifies task-critical objects and then acquires their geometry on demand. A 3D toolkit lifts zero-shot masks into a common coordinate frame, and a Symbolic 3D State Abstraction compresses object and camera states into structured text. Hierarchical Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) trains the VLM on cases in which geometry either helps or misleads, teaching it when to use tool evidence and when to fall back on visual cues. Think-Capture-4B reaches 54.4% on MindCube-Tiny (+21.5 points over its backbone), 39.1% on the MMSI-Bench positional subset (+7.9), and 42.8% on ViewSpatial (+5.2). It also remains robust under coordinate and mask perturbations. The full stack fits one 24 GB GPU and serves as an asynchronous high-level reasoner on an Agibot G1. Our code is available at https://github.com/819346675/Think-Capture.

papers.title_en: DewHand: Direct Metric World-Space Hand Motion Reconstruction from Egocentric Videos
papers.authors: Naru Suzuki, Satoshi Ikehata, Takehiko Ohkawa, Yoichi Sato, Shuhei Kurita
papers.evidence: 从第一人称视频恢复手部动作并支持迁移至具身智能体
papers.tldr: 第一视角视频中的手部运动可用于理解人类交互并迁移至具身智能体，但手与相机分阶段估计会累积误差，单目尺度不确定，遮挡及出画也使轨迹存在多种可能。DewHand在统一世界坐标系中联合重建手与相机，结合场景几何特征、米制监督和手部细节特征，以确定尺度并刻画关节动作。它将重建建模为条件流匹配生成，仅需两步采样，较直接回归更准确且时间更平滑。HOT3D、ARCTIC及跨设备零样本测试均显示其优势，提升世界空间精度与相机尺度恢复，为可靠交互理解及具身迁移提供支持。
papers.abstract_en: Recovering metric world-space hand motion from egocentric video supports understanding human interactions and transferring them to embodied agents. Three challenges complicate this task: multi-stage pipelines propagate errors from independently estimated hand and camera motion; monocular observations leave physical scale ambiguous; and occlusion and out-of-view hands admit multiple plausible motion trajectories. We present DewHand, a unified model for direct joint reconstruction of world-space hand and camera motion. To avoid compounding errors from multi-stage estimation, DewHand jointly predicts hand and camera motion in a shared world coordinate system within a single-stage pipeline. To resolve metric-scale ambiguity, it combines scene-level geometric features from VGGT-$Ω$ with metric-space supervision, while hand-specific features preserve fine-grained articulation. To handle occlusion and out-of-view hands, we formulate reconstruction as conditional motion generation with flow matching. Under the same architecture, this generative formulation outperforms direct regression in both accuracy and temporal smoothness with only two sampling steps. Experiments on HOT3D and ARCTIC demonstrate improved world-space accuracy and temporal consistency over state-of-the-art methods. DewHand reduces rigid-aligned world-space error relative to StableHand from 32.9 to 28.4 mm on HOT3D and from 76.2 to 36.2 mm on ARCTIC. It also recovers camera scale within 10% on two thirds of HOT3D clips, versus about a quarter for SLAM. Moreover, in zero-shot evaluations on HoloAssist, H2O, and TACO, captured with different devices, DewHand achieves the lowest rigid-aligned world-space error (WA-MPJPE) on each dataset.

papers.title_en: ClunoGS: Compact Language 3D Gaussian Splatting via Unified Optimization
papers.authors: Jian Xu, Yi Li, Ying Huang, Siyi Wu, Bingzhe Li, Yuede Ji, Miao Yin
papers.evidence: 语言特征与三维高斯结合以支持开放词汇场景理解
papers.tldr: 语言三维高斯溅射通过为高斯基元关联语言特征实现开放词汇场景理解，但语义属性增加存储开销。常见的先剪枝再量化方案若只关注渲染质量，可能删除对语义预测重要、却对RGB贡献较小的基元，且量化无法恢复其语义信息。ClunoGS提出语义感知剪枝与向量量化的统一约束优化，并交替更新各项变量，兼顾渲染、语义准确率和模型紧凑度。在LERF与ScanNet-10定位和分割评测中，该方法于激进压缩下更好地保留语义表现，说明联合优化优于独立或顺序压缩。
papers.abstract_en: Language 3D Gaussian Splatting enables open-vocabulary scene understanding by associating Gaussian primitives with language features. These semantic attributes increase model storage, while most existing 3DGS compression methods are designed mainly to preserve RGB rendering quality. One straightforward approach is to apply sparsification and quantization sequentially. However, pruning based only on rendering quality can remove Gaussians that have small RGB contributions but are important for semantic prediction. Once removed, their semantic information cannot be recovered by later quantization. We propose ClunoGS, a compact framework for Language 3DGS that combines semantics-aware Gaussian sparsification and vector quantization in a unified constrained objective. Semantic supervision is used during sparsification, and the objective jointly considers rendering quality, semantic accuracy, and compactness. We optimize the unified objective with alternating primal, sparsification, quantization, and dual updates. We evaluate ClunoGS on open-vocabulary localization and segmentation using the LERF and ScanNet-10 benchmarks. Under aggressive compression, our unified, semantics-aware formulation substantially alleviates the degradation of semantic representations caused by sequential compression and semantics-agnostic Gaussian sparsification. Ablations further show that jointly coordinating sparsification and quantization better preserves semantic accuracy than applying them independently.
